verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his W (Infernal Chains)-E combo before level 6; you win if you starve his Blood Well healing and out-scale into a Mortal Reminder-backed late game.

brief.thesis: Aatrox holds the lane because his W (Infernal Chains) threatens a full chain-pull into E (Umbral Dash) and Q (The Darkin Blade) from a range Garen can't contest without flash-in, which is why OP.GG's own numbers put this at 48% over 621 games with a listed lane and solo-kill advantage for him. The matchup is a resource fight, not a stat check: every point of Blood Well he doesn't get to heal off of, and every W he whiffs, is a window where Garen's flat stats and spin damage actually win the exchange.

theirWindow.when: His W (Infernal Chains) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He will walk up baiting a trade, then flick W for the pull; if it lands he dumps E and full Q chain into you for 40%+ HP. Hug minions and break line of sight of his hook rather than standing to trade auto-for-auto.

yourWindow.when: He whiffs W or has already used E to reposition
yourWindow.what: His engage and escape are both down for roughly 9-16 seconds depending on rank. Walk him down, land Q (Decisive Strike) for the silence and move speed, and hold E (Judgment) until he can't Umbral Dash away from it.

powerCurve.note: Q1 poke range beats your no-gap-closer kit
W-E-Q all-in threat outscales your E rank
Maxed W and boots let you contest trades
Mortal Reminder cuts his sustain, R executes

start.why: Runs 48.9% over 421 games and directly answers his poke-heavy Q1 harass while you farm behind minions per the intended defensive plan.

boots.why: 67.7% pick rate and the attack speed feeds your spin-to-win trades once you're actually allowed to fight him; Boots of Swiftness is the situational pick when his W chains are the bigger problem than his damage.

core.why: The rush path with this first hits 70.3% over 37 games because early grievous wounds directly guts the healing he gets off Blood Well stacks and R lifesteal.
Gives you the closing speed and waveclear you're missing pre-6, so you can actually punish his cooldown windows instead of only farming.
Attack speed scales your spin and autos for the sustained trades this matchup turns into once his all-in is spent.
Upgrades the grievous wounds so it holds through his ultimate healing, which is the single biggest thing keeping his win rate above yours in a fight.

situational.when: he keeps disengaging with E (Umbral Dash) after chaining you and you need speed to stick to him
you're ahead and want to match his dash mobility to force fights on your terms

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over the extended trades this lane turns into and grants healing, which is exactly what lets you out-sustain him once his W-E-Q combo is spent rather than winning on a single burst window you don't have.

summoners.why: 95.1% pick rate for a reason: Ignite's damage-over-time burns through his Blood Well healing during all-ins and secures kills he'd otherwise sustain through.

playing.title: Play around his W cooldown
playing.detail: Track when he's landed or whiffed Infernal Chains. Only stand for trades when it's down; otherwise stay at a range where the chain can't reach you.

playing.title: Deny CS to starve Blood Well
playing.detail: His passive heal comes off damage dealt, largely to minions and champions. Freezing the wave or zoning his last hits directly cuts the healing he'll have in a fight.

playing.title: Silence through his cast with Q
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence can cut off a W cast or delay his R activation if you time the engage right as he commits.

playing.title: Never extend past his E reset
playing.detail: Umbral Dash resets on a takedown, including minions in some trades. Don't chain a fight near a low-health wave he can reset off of to re-engage or escape.

playing.title: Farm to level 6, don't force it
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read here is correct: his all-in spikes hard at 3-5 and again at 6. Take free farm and wait for his cooldowns rather than manufacturing trades.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds before you need it
playing.detail: Rush Executioner's Calling into Mortal Reminder rather than reacting to his ult healing after the fact — it needs to be active before he pops R, not during.

playing.title: Save Ignite for the all-in, not poke
playing.detail: His sustain from Blood Well and R makes trades swing back in his favor over time. Ignite is worth more as a kill-securing/anti-heal tool in a real fight than chip damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, pick rates, and the full item/rune/summoner lists above are measured OP.GG data from real games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own analysis built to explain those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your distance from Aatrox considering the range of his abilities. Purchase Bramble Vest and focus on farming until his abilities are on cooldown to fight him.
